toggle_bulb.description: Turn a Wiz bulb ON or OFF.

change_color.description: Sets the color of the first discovered Wiz bulb using a HEX string.

set_brightness.description: Sets the brightness of the first discovered Wiz bulb.

temperature.description: Sets the color temperature of the first discovered Wiz bulb.

scenes.description: Sets a scene on Wiz bulb.

weather.description: Checks for rain within the next 7 days and provides the average daily temperature. Uses high-precision coordinates for the specified city or auto-detects location via IP if the city is omitted.

play_music.description: Plays music from the configured playlist. If query is provided, plays the closest matching track. If omitted, plays the full playlist from the beginning.

pause_resume_music.description: Pauses music if playing, resumes if paused.

play_radio.description: Plays a radio station by name. Searches favorites first, then falls back to a global radio database of 30,000+ stations from any country.

stop_radio.description: Stops the currently playing radio station.

play_channel.description: Plays the latest video audio from a subscribed YouTube or Rumble channel by name.
